description: Revoke the public share links of Besidka chats, so the links stop working. The chats themselves stay. Reports the slugs that were revoked and the ones that were not shared or are not your chats. Requires signing in (chats:write).

slugs.description: Chat slugs from list_chats or list_shared_chats, 1 to 90

name: revoke_chat_shares
title: Stop sharing chats
